shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc 'cat package.json && cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts && cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.cache.test.ts && cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.own-property.test.ts && cat .lore/test-commands.yml && git status --short && ls node_modules/ajv'

/bin/zsh -lc "git status -sb && git remote -v && node -p \"require('./node_modules/ajv/package.json').version\" && rg -n 'node_modules/ajv|\"ajv\"' package-lock.json && cat jest.config.js && cat tsconfig.json && cat specs/hal-engine-tool-input-validation/spec.md"

/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '4878,4900p' package-lock.json && cat node_modules/ajv/package.json | head -45 && cat src/orchestration/tools/registry.additional-property.test.ts && cat .github/workflows/ci.yml | head -110 && rg -n 'ajv' package-lock.json | head -20 && ls -a | rg 'AGENTS|npmrc' && git log -3 --oneline"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat AGENTS.md && git ls-files node_modules && ls node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv* && cat node_modules/ajv/dist/ajv.d.ts | head -25 && git show HEAD:package-lock.json | sed -n '4878,4894p' && rg -n 'ajv|registry' jest.config.js tsconfig* .github/workflows"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace(\"import {Ajv} from 'ajv/dist/ajv.js';\\nimport type {ValidateFunction} from 'ajv/dist/ajv.js';\", \"import {Ajv} from 'ajv';\\nimport type {ValidateFunction} from 'ajv';\")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/orchestration/tools/registry.cache.test.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace(\"  const firstCompileCount = compile.mock.calls.length;\", \"  expect(compile).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);\\n  expect(first.result).toContain('location');\").replace(\"    first: first.result.includes('location'),\\n    firstCompileCount,\\n\", '').replace(\"    compileCount: compile.mock.calls.length,\\n\", '').replace(\"  }).toEqual({first: true, firstCompileCount: 1, second: true, compileCount: 2});\", \"  }).toEqual({second: true});\\n  expect(compile).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);\")
p.write_text(s)
p=Path('src/orchestration/tools/registry.own-property.test.ts')
s=p.read_text().replace(\"    calls: executor.mock.calls.length,\\n\", '').replace(\"  }).toEqual({required: true, calls: 0});\", \"  }).toEqual({required: true});\\n  expect(executor).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\")
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.cache.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.own-property.test.ts
git diff"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('.lore/dod.md')
s=p.read_text().replace('- [ ] Resolve any remaining CI failures hidden by the truncated verdict.', '- [ ] Resolve any remaining CI failures hidden by the truncated verdict.').replace('- [x] Report the path of an explicitly disallowed additional property and repair visible CI type and lint failures.', '- [x] Report the path of an explicitly disallowed additional property and repair visible CI type and lint failures.\\n- [x] Repair the latest reported Ajv import and test lint findings.')
p.write_text(s)
PY
npx prettier --write .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.cache.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.own-property.test.ts
git add .lore/dod.md src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.cache.test.ts src/orchestration/tools/registry.own-property.test.ts
git commit -m 'fix(tools): repair CI import and lint findings'
git push origin HEAD
git fetch origin main
git merge origin/main --no-edit
git push origin HEAD
git status -sb"
